prompts.review_fab:
Review these PCB renders as a skeptical FABRICATOR/ASSEMBLER. You care about DFM: clearances, access, alignment, silkscreen, board utilization. Try to FAIL each check; pass only when the render clearly satisfies it.

Renders:
- 2d: /Users/johnbetts/Dropbox/Source/kicad-ai-workflow/output/mcu_core_v2/mcu_core_v2_2d.png
- 3d_iso: /Users/johnbetts/Dropbox/Source/kicad-ai-workflow/output/mcu_core_v2/mcu_core_v2_3d_iso.png
- 3d_iso_back: /Users/johnbetts/Dropbox/Source/kicad-ai-workflow/output/mcu_core_v2/mcu_core_v2_3d_iso_back.png
- 3d_top: /Users/johnbetts/Dropbox/Source/kicad-ai-workflow/output/mcu_core_v2/mcu_core_v2_3d_top.png

Checks:
- fab_clearances (views: 2d, 3d_top): Do all component bodies/courtyards keep visible assembly clearance (no touching or near-touching parts, including between THT bodies and neighboring passives)?
- fab_connector_access (views: 2d, 3d_top, 3d_iso): Is every connector/terminal at a board edge with its wire/plug opening facing OUTWARD, and is the area between each connector and its edge completely clear (screwdriver and cable access)?
- fab_grid_alignment (views: 2d): Do repeated subcircuits have IDENTICAL layouts, and do components form aligned rows/columns rather than scattered or ragged placement?
- fab_silkscreen (views: 2d): Are reference designators legible, near their parts, and not overlapping pads or other text?
- fab_board_utilization (views: 2d): Is the board area used proportionately — no large dead regions while another area is congested, and no component stranded far from its functional group?

Answer with ONLY a JSON array, one object per check:
[{"check_id": "...", "passed": true|false, "refs": ["R1", ...], "evidence": "one sentence"}]
A check that does not apply to this board (e.g. no RF module) passes with evidence "not applicable".
prompts.review_ee:
Review these PCB renders as a skeptical ELECTRICAL ENGINEER. You care about signal integrity, decoupling, isolation, RF, and routability. Try to FAIL each check; pass only when the render clearly satisfies it.

Renders:
- 2d: /Users/johnbetts/Dropbox/Source/kicad-ai-workflow/output/mcu_core_v2/mcu_core_v2_2d.png
- 3d_iso: /Users/johnbetts/Dropbox/Source/kicad-ai-workflow/output/mcu_core_v2/mcu_core_v2_3d_iso.png
- 3d_iso_back: /Users/johnbetts/Dropbox/Source/kicad-ai-workflow/output/mcu_core_v2/mcu_core_v2_3d_iso_back.png
- 3d_top: /Users/johnbetts/Dropbox/Source/kicad-ai-workflow/output/mcu_core_v2/mcu_core_v2_3d_top.png

Checks:
- ee_domain_zoning (views: 2d): Do voltage domains form contiguous zones with field wiring at its own board edge? The 24V/relay-contact side must hug the edge where its harness terminal sits — high voltage must never have to cross the board interior, and low-voltage digital lines must not run through the relay/24V zone to reach a terminal. Ferrite-isolated analog must be one contiguous region apart from the digital section.
- ee_decoupling (views: 2d): Is every decoupling capacitor immediately adjacent to the IC power pin it serves (a few mm, no other part between)?
- ee_signal_flow (views: 2d): Do subcircuit chains read in signal order (input -> processing -> output) without doubling back across the group?
- ee_crossing_attach_lines (views: 2d): For each paired connector/part pin row (relay contacts to screw terminal, ADC channel to its terminal), would the straight pad-to-pad connections cross each other? Crossing pairs force avoidable crossover traces.
- ee_isolation (views: 2d): Are mains/high-voltage parts (relays, their terminals) separated from logic by a visible gap or isolation slot, with no logic part inside the isolation region?
- ee_rf_antenna (views: 2d, 3d_top): If an RF module is present, is its antenna section at a board edge with the keepout free of components and copper?
- ee_power_topology (views: 2d): Does power flow input -> protection/filter -> regulation -> loads in placement order, with bulk capacitors at the input side of their regulator?

Answer with ONLY a JSON array, one object per check:
[{"check_id": "...", "passed": true|false, "refs": ["R1", ...], "evidence": "one sentence"}]
A check that does not apply to this board (e.g. no RF module) passes with evidence "not applicable".

Review these PCB renders as a skeptical fabricator. Try to FAIL each check; pass only when the render clearly satisfies it.

Renders:
- 2d: /Users/johnbetts/Dropbox/Source/kicad-ai-workflow/output/mcu_core_v2/mcu_core_v2_2d.png
- 3d_iso: /Users/johnbetts/Dropbox/Source/kicad-ai-workflow/output/mcu_core_v2/mcu_core_v2_3d_iso.png
- 3d_iso_back: /Users/johnbetts/Dropbox/Source/kicad-ai-workflow/output/mcu_core_v2/mcu_core_v2_3d_iso_back.png
- 3d_top: /Users/johnbetts/Dropbox/Source/kicad-ai-workflow/output/mcu_core_v2/mcu_core_v2_3d_top.png

Checks:
- bodies_no_overlap (views: 3d_top, 3d_iso, 3d_iso_back): Do any two component bodies intersect or stack on each other? Any overlap of 3D bodies is a FAIL regardless of pad geometry.
- bodies_flat_on_board (views: 3d_iso, 3d_iso_back): Is every component body sitting flat on the PCB surface (not floating, not sunken, not tilted)?
- bodies_on_pads (views: 3d_top): Does every component body sit centered over its own pads (no body displaced from its footprint)?
- orientation_sane (views: 2d, 3d_top): Are connectors opening toward board edges, relays aligned as a uniform row, and polarized parts consistently oriented?
- antenna_zone_clear (views: 2d, 3d_top): Is the RF antenna keepout region (if any) at a board edge and completely free of components and copper?
- groups_visually_coherent (views: 2d): Do functional groups read as tight, organized, grid-aligned clusters rather than scattered parts?

Answer with ONLY a JSON array, one object per check:
[{"check_id": "...", "passed": true|false, "refs": ["R1", ...], "evidence": "one sentence"}]
